test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends Haroon, Imran, Jason, Kirti, Lisa, Mohan, and Niti having different heights, are standing in descending order of their heights. The tallest person stands at the front and the shortest person stands at the last of the column. Haroon stands immediately behind Lisa, who stands immediately behind Kirti. There are exactly two people standing in between Mohan and Niti. Imran is standing in the second position from the front. Mohan is not the tallest. Who is standing at the front of the column?
solution:
Given: Seven friends Haroon, Imran, Jason, Kirti, Lisa, Mohan, and Niti.

The tallest person stands at the front and the shortest person stands at the last of the column.

1) Imran is standing in the second position from the front.

__ > Imran > __ > __ > __ > __ > __

2) There are exactly two people standing in between Mohan and Niti.

3) Mohan is not the tallest.

4) Haroon stands immediately behind Lisa, who stands immediately behind Kirti.

These statements implies that Mohan will sit on the 4th from the starting, because 3 person Kirti, Lisa and Haroon sits at the immediate positions.

Niti > Imran > __ > Mohan > Kirti > Lisa > Haroon

And, Jason will sit at the remaining place.

Niti > Imran > Jason > Mohan > Kirti > Lisa > Haroon

Here,** 'Niti'** is standing at the front of the column.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
